use_case_name: Publish Air and Surface Surveillance Tracks

claims.content: The C2 JU begins publishing/transmitting air or surface surveillance tracks after sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration have been performed.
After successful publication of an Inactive or Limited Status Interface Unit (IU) track, the C² JU reports it as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG with Identity reported as Friend.
The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator are reported as value 1, and are maintained if another C² JU assumes R² of the IU.
A new local track with no tentative correlation found on the initial correlation test is transmitted.
A new local track that tentatively correlates on the initial test but fails correlation on the next test is transmitted.
If the automatic correlation test fails during execution, the system assigns a new Track Number (TN B) to the local track and reports TN B in a J3.2 or J3.3 message with an initial ID of Pending.
The C2 JU publishes air and surface surveillance tracks to the Surveillance Network after sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration have been performed.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The C2 JU publishes air and surface surveillance tracks to the Surveillance Network after sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration have been performed.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The C2 JU has an air or surface track available for publication, sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration have been performed, and the track is published as a track or point on the Surveillance Network.
scope_contract.start_boundary: A reportable air/surface track is available after sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration have been performed.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The air/surface track has been transmitted/published as a track or point on the Surveillance Network.
in_scope_actions: Publishing/transmitting the air or surface track to the Surveillance Network
excluded_adjacent_actions: Common tracking (sharing a common track number and shifting R² between C2 JUs)
variant_dimensions: Publication as a track vs as a point
